settings.title: What products do you offer?
settings.text: We focus on sealed Pokémon and One Piece items — including booster boxes, booster bundles, and ETBs. We also carry display accessories like acrylic cases.

settings.title: Do you offer bundles or deals?
settings.text: Yes. We offer simplified bundles when they provide better value. You'll also find tiered discounts based on order total.

settings.title: Do you sell singles?
settings.text: Not at the moment. We specialize in sealed products only.

settings.title: Will you carry accessories like acrylic cases?
settings.text: Yes. We sell clear acrylic display cases to help protect and showcase your sealed collection.

settings.title: Will you expand beyond sealed?
settings.text: Possibly — but for now, we're a sealed-first shop.

settings.title: LAUNCH & PRODUCTS

settings.title: Do orders include tracking?
settings.text: Yes. We ship with tracking so you can follow your package end-to-end.

settings.title: How do you package orders?
settings.text: We pack sealed items to protect corners and shrink wrap, using sturdy packaging and fill as needed so items arrive clean.

settings.title: Where do you ship from?
settings.text: We ship from Maryland, USA. Every order is packed carefully to protect sealed condition and ships with tracking.

settings.title: Shipping
settings.section_class: sb-card sb-card--pad-md sb-card--border-muted sb-card--shadow-soft sb-heading-ink sb-body-slate sb-faq sb-faq-card sb-faq-stack sb-h2 sb-body sb-faq-page sb-faq-section sb-page-section

settings.title: Are your products authentic and factory-sealed?
settings.text: Yes. We only sell authentic Pokémon TCG products. Sealed items are factory-sealed as received. If anything looks compromised, we won’t ship it.

settings.title: What is your return policy?
settings.text:
All sales are final on sealed Pokémon products. We do not accept returns on opened items.

If your order arrives damaged or there’s an issue with delivery, contact us and we’ll make it right.
